caption:
You split R$20 a day across six ad sets, and then wondered why nothing worked.

Each one got about R$3. At that level there is no delivery, no learning, no data — six campaigns all failing quietly and simultaneously, and no way to tell which idea was actually good.

Beginners do this because it feels like control. More ad sets, more tests, more buttons that look like strategy. It's the opposite: you've taken one small budget and made it six budgets too small to produce a signal.

If your budget is small, concentrate it. One campaign, one ad set, a handful of creatives inside it, and let the system do what it's actually good at — figuring out which creative works on whom.

Testing is a luxury that starts somewhere above R$50 a day per test. Below that, you are not running experiments. You are paying for the illusion of them.
